strings.zh: 船长『让精灵学会居合斩的话,{NEWLINE}就能斩断路上的小树了,{CLEAR}是很方便的技能哦。
strings.en: Captain: Teach a Pokémon Cut, and it{NEWLINE}can cut down small trees in your path.{CLEAR}It’s a very handy move.

strings.zh: 广播『各位旅客,{NEWLINE}本游轮的豪华派对即将开始。{CLEAR}欢迎大家到大厅来参加派对。
strings.en: Announcement: Attention, passengers.{NEWLINE}Our grand party is about to begin.{SCROLL}Please join us in the main hall.

strings.zh: 船长『哎呀,派对好像开始了,{NEWLINE}你快去参加派对吧。{CLEAR}我们圣安努号的派对可是很热闹的。
strings.en: Captain: Oh my, sounds like the party’s{NEWLINE}started. Hurry along and join in.{SCROLL}Parties on the S.S. Anne are always{NEWLINE}lively.

strings.zh: 船长『派对已经开始了,{NEWLINE}你快去参加派对吧。{CLEAR}我们圣安努号的派对可是很热闹的。
strings.en: Captain: The party’s already started.{NEWLINE}Hurry along and join in.{SCROLL}Parties on the S.S. Anne are always{NEWLINE}lively.

strings.zh: 马志士大人！{NEWLINE}又发现了一具遇难者遗体！
strings.en: Lt. Surge, sir! We found another{NEWLINE}victim’s body!

strings.zh: 马志士『等等！{NEWLINE}如果他穿着救生衣的话……{SCROLL}马志士『他还有呼吸！
strings.en: Lt. Surge: Wait! If he’s wearing a life{NEWLINE}jacket...{SCROLL}Lt. Surge: He’s still breathing!

strings.zh: 马志士『快来帮忙！发现生还者了！
strings.en: Lt. Surge: Over here! We’ve got a{NEWLINE}survivor!

strings.zh: 马志士大人！{NEWLINE}这边两个穿救生衣的人也还有呼吸！
strings.en: Lt. Surge, sir! These two in life{NEWLINE}jackets are still breathing too!

strings.zh: 马志士『那还磨蹭什么！{NEWLINE}快把他们送去抢救！
strings.en: Lt. Surge: Then what are you waiting{NEWLINE}for?! Get them to emergency care, now!

strings.zh: 你好,我是新圣安努号的船长。{NEWLINE}船上全区域对游客开放参观,{CLEAR}希望你能玩得愉快。
strings.en: Hello, I’m the captain{NEWLINE}of the new S.S. Anne.{CLEAR}The whole ship is open to visitors.{SCROLL}I hope you enjoy yourself.

strings.zh: 你好,欢迎来到新圣安努号。{NEWLINE}作为第1000位到访的旅客,{CLEAR}请收下我为您准备的特别礼物。
strings.en: Hello, and welcome to the new S.S. Anne.{NEWLINE}As our 1000th visitor...{SCROLL}...please accept this special gift I’ve{NEWLINE}prepared for you.

strings.zh: 祝你在新圣安努号上玩得愉快。
strings.en: Enjoy your time aboard the new{NEWLINE}S.S. Anne.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『可恶,等级差太多了……
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Damn it, the level gap is too{NEWLINE}big...

strings.zh: 水吾桐『哈哈哈,自寻死路的家伙。{NEWLINE}铁螯龙虾,给我剪断这个小鬼的脖子！
strings.en: Archie: Ha ha ha! You’re just digging{NEWLINE}your own grave. Crawdaunt, snip this{CLEAR}brat’s head off!
strings.notes: Faithful: zh 剪断这个小鬼的脖子 ('snip this brat's neck'). | Full fidelity review: specific wording approved by user (D-1724, 2026-10-07). | RV052: softened: 自寻死路 carries death; ‘You asked for it’ was weaker

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『如你所愿,我正陷入苦战呢。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Just like you hoped, I’m in a{NEWLINE}tough fight.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『你能来真是太好了,{NEWLINE}敌人不是一般的强,{CLEAR}再打下去我可能就撑不住了。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: I’m so glad you came.{NEWLINE}This guy’s way stronger{CLEAR}than a normal enemy.{SCROLL}I might not have lasted much longer.

strings.zh: 水吾桐『阻挡我水吾桐计划的人,{NEWLINE}只有一个下场,{CLEAR}那就是——死！
strings.en: Archie: Anyone who gets in the way of my{NEWLINE}plans meets only one end...{SCROLL}...death!
